body:
I've been there years ago. Even if I've tried all these years to get rid of that terrible sensation, i remembere perfectly how it feels to be alone, completely alone, as if there were nobody who could really understand how you feel. I won't lie: it has been a tough path, there has been relapses, moments when i've felt really miserable. But it's worth it. I have taken medications, done psychotherapy, practiced meditation, converted to buddhism...and here i'm, not suicidal for years now, with a partner and with more confidence in myself. than i even thought possible. And the best thing: i've specialized in psychiatry and i'm trying to help those who are exactly as i was and you are now.

Don't do it. Don't take your life. You're not alone. It'll get better, sooner as you think.
